payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over digit positions, reducing the number so that trailing digits become 9, then computes digit product; effectively checks candidate numbers with maximal product by bounding search space.
payload.rationale: The algorithm does not enumerate all numbers but explores a small set of candidates derived from n by setting suffixes to 9. This resembles branch and bound with pruning, though not typical; best fit among given complete search subtypes.
